only used a sender-pay model

claim: By default a transit gateway allocates data processing charges to the account that owns the source attachment; since Flexible Cost Allocation (November 21, 2025) a metering policy can instead allocate charges to the destination attachment owner or the transit gateway owner.

values.display: account that owns the source attachment
values.spoken: the source attachment owner pays by default

values.display: owns the destination attachment
owns the transit gateway

evidence.quote: By default, transit gateway uses a sender-based cost allocation model where data processing charges are allocated to the account that owns the source attachment.
**Destination attachment owner** - Charges are allocated to the account that owns the destination attachment
**Transit Gateway owner** - Charges are allocated to the account that owns the transit gateway
Previously, Transit Gateway only used a sender-pay model, where the source attachment account owner was responsible for all data usage related costs.

changed.was: Transit Gateway only used a sender-pay model

note: Older exam questions assume the sender always pays. Checked against the metering-policy page and the What's New post.
